slots.jd.tax-firm.about:
About us and the job
Redwood Tax and Bookkeeping is a small, owner-run accounting firm in Sacramento, CA. We look after the books and tax work for local businesses and families, and we know our clients by name. We are hiring a Staff Accountant to join our team in the office. This job is on site, and you will work closely with the owners and the rest of our small staff every day.
slots.jd.tax-firm.duties:
What the job involves
- Prepare monthly financial statements for our business clients
- Review vendor invoices for accuracy, coding and approval before payment
- Complete bank reconciliations and follow up on any differences
- Post adjustments and keep client ledgers up to date
- Help gather records and answer client questions during busy periods
- Work with the owners to make sure files are complete and ready for review
slots.jd.tax-firm.needs:
What you need
- 1 or more years of experience in an accounting or bookkeeping role
- Working knowledge of journal entries, month-end close and budget variance analysis
- Hands-on experience with fixed asset tracking and sales tax filing
- Familiarity with SAP
- Bookkeeping Certificate (required)
- Certified Public Accountant Licence (preferred)
slots.r1.b1: Prepares payroll accounting records and supporting schedules for audit preparation, reducing auditor follow-up requests by 10 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Reconciles bank accounts and ties fixed asset tracking records to the general ledger so differences are cleared before close.
slots.r1.b3: Builds Microsoft Excel checklists and reconciliation templates for month-end close, cutting the time needed to close the books by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Records journal entries for accruals and adjustments and drafts financial statements for senior review.
slots.r1.i1: Prepares monthly financial statements at Northfield Group as a staff accountant, working from the general ledger with senior review.
slots.r1.i2: Reviews vendor invoices at Northfield Group for accuracy and proper approval before they are entered and paid.
slots.summary.1: Associate-level accounting professional with about 1 year of experience as a staff accountant, handling routine requests with a colleague checking the work. Skilled in Microsoft Excel, journal entries and payroll accounting, with a B.S. in Accounting and a Bookkeeping Certificate.
slots.summary.2: Staff accountant with about 1 year of experience handling routine accounting requests, with each task checked by a colleague before it is finalized. Uses Microsoft Excel daily to support journal entries, payroll accounting and account reconciliation.
